title: Browser job apt stall: two stalls ended on the same package, libflite1 (13.6 MB)
description: LEAD ONLY, cause open, nothing fixed. In "Install browser system deps" (apt half of the explorer browser job) two stalls ended on the 63rd Get:, libflite1 (noble/universe, 13.6 MB): (1) run 39830280984 attempt 1, job 120004301250, cancelled by a human after ~20 min; (2) opum-ai/lore-cli#658 run 39870150073 attempt 1, job 120142258699, where the 20-minute native step bound fired and failed red at 2026-10-22T23:32:00Z (step began 23:11:47Z). Both last logged Get:62 libbs2b0 then Get:63 libflite1. Passing re-runs of the same step: 24 s (run 39870150073 attempt 2) and 29 s (main push run 39873358281, job 120152888276). The other four LCLI-753 stalls (39819294463 at Get:161, 39836856767 at Get:102, 39857554409 at Get:107, 39863242046 at Get:177) stopped at different packages, so libflite1 may be coincidence. Open questions: is that file slow/hung on the azure mirror; does the stall begin before or after Get:63; would a different mirror or Acquire settings matter.
